correctness.rationale: For each admissible index, a trace calculation keeps the rational maps inside the nonzero trace-one fiber. Exact binary polynomial identities factor the second-iterate equation into seven pairwise distinct irreducibles. Their penultimate coefficients are one, so absolute-trace parity over extensions counts each root; separately factoring the fixed-point equation and dividing by two proves every number in the table. The supplied standalone checker reproduces symbolic identities and fully enumerates degrees 1 through 15. Unproved longer-cycle behavior is outside the claim.

value.rationale: The count is a complete dynamical short-cycle invariant for all four naturally classified basic Kloosterman permutations. It supplies a uniform sharp bound, precise degree-five and degree-ten resonance, and positive/zero existence criteria for each low period over every binary extension. These distinctions cannot be read from the classical permutation property alone; the result does not need a claim about all cycles to be a meaningful mathematical refinement.
